arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database was due to 47 malformed rows blocking the retry queue. These rows were deleted, unblocking the queue and allowing the backlog to be processed.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the failed-jobs table to prevent future backlogs and ensure jobs are properly formatted.
